topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The neon's going cold, the doors locking shut, and the last of the regulars are drifting away, leaving only their echoes behind. Place like this, it's more than just a diner; it's a spot where the world outside gets to be just a little bit less hard. I remember the smell of fresh coffee, the sizzle of the grill, the way the waitress always had a kind word, even at four in the morning when the night is dragging its feet. They say the city never sleeps, but now a piece of it will rest for good. Ain't no use in crying over greasy spoons, but it's damn hard not to.
